title: Moving Towards Epistemic Autonomy: A Paradigm Shift for Centering Participant Knowledge
reasoning: The paper focuses on establishing 'epistemic autonomy' as a research paradigm. It evaluates and applies concepts of epistemology (e.g., situated knowledge, standpoint epistemology) and hermeneutics (e.g., hermeneutical injustice, sensemaking) as core components of its theoretical framework for HCI research.
